keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Vincent Janssen (Portland Timbers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Herman Johansson (FC Dallas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Alexander Aravena replaces Ariel Lassiter.
